text:
F1S: secondary-host fixes and gaps found while wiring scar3 (8 items)
Reason: restoring the F1S flow and free pool on host scar3 (local_curator=ai_scar3, no ai_darkhero folder) exposed these. Evidence: hub commit 36d39f9a4fb2a368e29ee5d55e0b5657ad622cd3 on branch codex/scar3-tray-consolidation-20260810; _registry/fleet-rogue-schedulers.json.

Fixed locally, please absorb upstream:
1. os.path.isjunction needs Python 3.12; scar3 runs 3.11.9. f1s_control.py, fleet-hygiene.py, fleet-residue-quarantine.py, fleet-skill-sync.py now use os.lstat(path).st_reparse_tag == stat.IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT.
2. agc_lib.py:173 fix, same commit.
3. _harness/runtime/fames_session_harness.py precompact_hook_probe ignored hook args, so a pythonw + args row read as unarmed. Fix is on disk only: hub .gitignore:10 "runtime/" also ignores _harness/runtime/*, so harness edits cannot be committed normally. That ignore rule needs an exception.

Not fixed, needs a decision upstream:
4. fleet-skill-sync deploy ignored --dry-run (crashed in deploy path instead of dry-running).
5. f1s_apply.py:102 AREA_SEAT and :571 route(curator="ai_darkhero") are hard-coded; add() at :755-757 raises ValueError "no seat" when HUB/<seat>/AGENTS.md is absent. article_relay.TOPIC_SEATS names seats unregistered on this host and curator_orders.issue raises uncaught in relay(). Measured on scar3: test_f1s_apply 12 failed/66 passed, test_article_relay 1 failed/24 passed; with an in-memory simulation of the darkhero host, 102 passed/1 failed. Suggest resolving the curator from _registry/machine.json local_curator.
6. keypool-tick @04:30 refreshes availability for the curator seat only; other seats go stale after 168h unless AI_SEAT=<seat> python api_registry.py sync --apply.
7. fleet-rogue-scheduler-sweep flags repo-schtasks-scripts=17 for ai_wallpaper, but all 17 hits are text mentions (AGENTS.md lines 20 and 24, accountability-unblock/SKILL.md, and claude-proof-hook.py/fleet-hygiene.py copies under skill surfaces). No installer script exists. The scan should exclude skill surfaces and the charter, otherwise the fix "delete the script" cannot be satisfied and the portal stays red.
8. fleet-rogue-scheduler-sweep.py --help runs a real sweep and rewrites _registry/fleet-rogue-schedulers.json.
